pages.text: A golem sword that casts a spell on every hit, like the Enchanter's Sword. Place it on a Scribe's Table, make a spell in your spell book, then shift-right click the table with that spell active. The spell must not have a Form glyph: the weapon provides Touch.$(br2)Ars Nouveau does not charge golems mana, so casts are limited by a cooldown (and an optional cost cap) in the config. Crafted at an Enchanting Apparatus from the matching diamond golem weapon.
